美國勞工統計局週五公布，8 月消費者物價指數 (CPI) 月增 0.4%，年增率維持在 3.4%。排除食品與能源後，核心 CPI 月增 0.3%，略高於市場預期，年增率則由 2.5%放緩至 2.4%。
其中，排除住房的核心服務價格月增 0.5%，創 1 月以來最大增幅。航空票價也在航空燃油成本上漲之際月增 2.7%，較去年同期大漲 23.4%，顯示油價衝擊可能已開始向服務價格擴散。
數據公布後一小時內，根據 CME FedWatch，市場預估 Fed 下週升息的機率由前一日的 73%躍升至 85.8%，遠高於一週前的 60%。對貨幣政策敏感的美國 2 年期公債殖利率也升至 4.613%，創 52 週新高。
市場亦將焦點轉向華許。
華許並未承諾在 9 月 15 日至 16 日的會議上升息，但他此前已表明，若通膨未能降溫，Fed便有必要提高利率。他在 8 月 28 日的傑克森霍爾演說中指出，通膨仍高於 Fed 的 2%目標，因此央行目前應將物價列為首要關注焦點。
華許當時也淡化今夏部分通膨數據改善的意義，認為短期 CPI 與個人消費支出物價指數 (PCE) 優於預期，不代表基礎通膨趨勢已出現實質改善。最新數據顯示，整體 PCE 年增率仍達 3.7%。
同時，Fed內部對是否立即升息仍存在分歧。
Fed 理事華勒與紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯在會議前較傾向等待更多數據，再決定是否需要升息。華勒本月初曾表示，如果通膨降溫趨勢持續，他將傾向支持維持利率不變，並將 8 月 CPI 視為重要判斷依據。
華爾街分析師認為，最新通膨數據可能促使華勒等中間派官員轉向支持升息。
Capital Economics 經濟學家 Stephen Brown認為，綜合 8 月 CPI 與生產者物價指數 (PPI)，核心 PCE 可能月增 0.3%，通膨走勢正朝不利方向發展，應足以讓華勒支持下週升息。
Brown 也認為，如果主張觀望的官員仍不願升息，華許便必須決定，是等待聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 日後接受他的判斷，還是運用主席影響力，說服潛在反對者支持立即行動。
這場內部分歧也牽動華許的領導地位。華勒先前曾批評華許的部分建議「奇怪」。
據《華爾街日報》報導，他也曾私下否定華許成立、用來檢視 Fed 未來方向的工作小組。若華許此時退讓，可能讓華勒取代他，成為 Fed 政策辯論的思想重心。
華許同時承受來自白宮的政治壓力。
川普持續要求 Fed 降息，儘管他也聲稱相信華許會依照自己的判斷行事。部分分析人士推測，華許可能不會在 11 月 3 日期中選舉前升息，但目前沒有證據顯示，他制定利率政策時考量了自身經濟判斷以外的因素。
市場利率上升也引發另一種解讀，即華許可能選擇不調整政策利率，讓市場自行收緊金融環境。自他出任 Fed 主席以來，美債殖利率全面走高，10 年期美債殖利率週五早盤升至4.95%。華許7月曾表示，Fed採取的行動不多，但市場已經做了很多。
Fed 9 月會議因此不只是一場升息表決，更將檢驗華許能否將自己的通膨立場轉化為政策。
若他未能展現決策主導權，投資人、Fed官員及社會大眾可能轉而認為，川普、財長貝森特或華勒才是實際影響政策的人物，並因不確定性升高而進一步推升長期美債殖利率。
paras_en: U.S. core inflation in August posted the biggest rise in four months, prompting markets to sharply increase bets on a rate hike by the Federal Reserve, making next week's policy meeting a crucial test for Fed Chair Jerome Powell since taking office. If Powell, after multiple warning inflation readings, still refrains from raising rates, markets may question whether his words match his actions and whether he truly controls Fed decision‑making.

The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics released on Friday that the Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 0.4% month‑over‑month in August, with the year‑over‑year rate holding at 3.4%. Excluding food and energy, core CPI increased 0.3% month‑over‑month, slightly above expectations, while the annual rate eased to 2.4% from 2.5%.

Within core CPI, core services excluding housing rose 0.5% month‑over‑month, the largest gain since January. Airline fares also jumped 2.7% as jet‑fuel costs rose, up 23.4% from a year earlier, indicating that oil‑price pressures may be spreading to service prices.

Within an hour of the data release, CME FedWatch showed the market’s probability of a Fed hike next week climbing from 73% the day before to 85.8%, well above the 60% level a week earlier. The yield on the U.S. 2‑year Treasury, which is sensitive to monetary policy, rose to 4.613%, a 52‑week high.
Markets also turned their focus to Powell.

Powell has not pledged to raise rates at the September 15‑16 meeting, but he has previously signaled that if inflation does not cool, the Fed will need to increase rates. In his Jackson Hole speech on August 28, he noted that inflation remains above the Fed’s 2% target, so price stability should remain the central focus of the central bank.

Powell also downplayed the significance of some summer inflation data improvements, saying that short‑term CPI and personal consumption expenditures (PCE) numbers that beat expectations do not indicate a substantive improvement in underlying inflation trends. The latest data show that overall PCE inflation is still 3.7% year‑over‑year.
At the same time, there remains internal disagreement within the Fed about whether to raise rates immediately.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller and New York Fed President John Williams leaned toward waiting for more data before deciding on a hike. Waller said earlier this month that if the cooling trend in inflation persists, he would be inclined to support keeping rates steady and would treat the August CPI as a key judgment point.
Wall Street analysts think the latest inflation numbers could push centrist officials like Waller toward supporting a rate increase.

Capital Economics economist Stephen Brown believes that, combining August CPI with the producer price index (PPI), core PCE could rise 0.3% month‑over‑month, indicating an unfavorable inflation trajectory that should be enough to sway Waller to back a hike next week.

Brown also says that if hold‑out officials continue to resist a hike, Powell will have to decide whether to wait for the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) to eventually accept his view or to use his chairmanship influence to persuade potential opponents to act immediately.
This internal split also tugs at Powell’s leadership standing. Waller has previously criticized some of Powell’s suggestions as “odd.”

According to the Wall Street Journal, Waller also privately dismissed the working group Powell set up to assess the Fed’s future direction. If Powell backs down now, it could allow Waller to replace him as the intellectual focal point of Fed policy debates.
Powell is also under political pressure from the White House.

President Trump continues to urge the Fed to cut rates, even as he claims to trust Powell to act on his own judgment. Some analysts speculate that Powell may avoid a hike before the November 3 election, but there is no evidence that his rate decisions are influenced by anything beyond his own economic assessment.

Rising market rates have sparked another interpretation: Powell might choose not to adjust the policy rate and let market forces tighten financial conditions. Since he became Fed chair, U.S. Treasury yields have risen across the board, with the 10‑year Treasury hitting 4.95% in early trading on Friday. Powell said in July that the Fed has taken few actions, but the market has already done a lot.
Thus, the September Fed meeting is not just a vote on a rate hike; it will also test whether Powell can translate his inflation stance into policy.

If he fails to demonstrate decisive authority, investors, Fed officials and the public may come to view Trump, Treasury Secretary Yellen, or Waller as the real policy influencers, and the added uncertainty could push long‑term Treasury yields even higher.

items.title: 蘋果1999美元摺疊iPhone「太便宜」華爾街憂利潤承壓
paras: 《Benzinga》報導，蘋果(AAPL-US)首款摺疊iPhone的定價低於華爾街預期。而對於追蹤蘋果股票的分析師而言，這恰恰成了問題所在。
起售價1,999美元的iPhone Duo獲得廣泛好評。蘋果周三在新品發表會上正式揭曉這款產品，這也是執行長特納斯(John Ternus)上任後主持的首場重大產品發表會。
市場擔心的是，這款價格低於預期的iPhone，將如何影響蘋果每支手機的獲利。

美銀看好Duo 但擔心價格帶來影響

美國銀行證券分析師Wamsi Mohan對蘋果股票重申「買進」評級，但將目標價從380美元下調至370美元。
Mohan表示，「在我們看來，iPhone Duo成為整場發表會的焦點。」
他指出，摺疊螢幕讓手機具備類似iPad的生產力功能，為蘋果開啟更大的市場。他也認為，隨著時間推進，這種新外型設計可能逐漸成為主流。
在發表會前，美銀原本預期摺疊iPhone售價為2,099美元，且Pro系列價格將上調150至200美元。但最終Duo售價為1,999美元，iPhone 18 Pro與Pro Max則各上調100美元，分別為1,199美元與1,299美元。
價格較低，可能帶來更高的銷量。但也可能意味著更低的獲利。
Mohan將2026會計年度的iPhone出貨量預估上調200萬支，2027則上調500萬支，兩個年度均預估為2.56億支。他目前預期蘋果在9月季度出貨5,400萬支iPhone，高於原先預估的5,200萬支。
與此同時，他將2027會計年度的iPhone平均售價預估下調14美元至1,099美元。
這個數字代表蘋果每支iPhone平均取得的收入。
隨著記憶體及零組件成本上升，較低的售價將壓縮毛利率，也就是蘋果每取得1美元銷售收入，在支付產品製造成本後能保留下來的比例。
因此，美銀將2027會計年度每股盈餘預估從9.92美元下調至9.46美元。370美元的目標價，是以美銀對2027年曆年每股盈餘9.98美元的預估值乘以37倍本益比計算而來，原先則是以10.32美元為基礎。

TD Cowen維持看多 Rosenblatt仍持謹慎

TD Cowen維持對蘋果股票的「買進」評級及400美元目標價。
該機構表示，幅度溫和的價格調漲有助於產品負擔能力，但未來一年可能進一步加劇硬體毛利率面臨的壓力。TD Cowen預估，蘋果在2026下半年將出貨約600萬支Duo。
Rosenblatt分析師Barton Crockett則維持「中立」評級及303美元目標價。
Crockett表示，隨著記憶體成本上升，蘋果較為克制的定價策略可能對毛利率造成壓力。
三家機構，三種不同的目標價。但有一項共同擔憂。
根據Benzinga分析師評級資料，追蹤蘋果的29名分析師對該股的共識評級為「買進」。平均目標價為335美元。近期分析師目標價則介於Barclays的245美元，以及TD Cowen與Rothschild & Co.的400美元之間。

items.title: 從產線到舞台！2026日月光好聲音各廠區員工同台獻唱
items.title_en: From Production Line to Stage! 2026 Sunshine Good Voice Show Features Employees from All Facilities Singing Together
paras: 日月光投控(3711-TW)(ASX-US)旗下日月光文教基金會與日月光集團聯合職工福利委員會於昨(11)日共同主辦「2026 日月光好聲音」，今年賽事吸引台灣區297位同仁報名，19位選手晉級決賽，最終由姜宛林奪下華語組冠軍、Timothy John Cachero拿下外語組冠軍。
「日月光好聲音」是「2026 日月光音樂季」的年度系列活動之一，期望透過這場賽事，提供專業的指導與陪伴，讓同仁在工作之餘有一個展現自己的舞台，同時也讓外界看見半導體廠不一樣的一面。
日月光文教基金會董事長吳田玉表示，外界常覺得半導體封測廠的生活就是上班下班、輪班、加班，其實日月光全球近十萬名同仁，不少人平常就很會唱歌，只是沒有機會讓別人看見。好聲音安排一對一指導和樂團彩排，就是希望給他們一個平台，在專業的舞台上好好唱一首自己喜歡的歌，也透過全程直播，縮短外籍同仁與家人的距離。

297位同仁報名 各廠區選手同台競演

這項賽事自2022年起由高雄廠舉辦，今年邁入第五屆。日月光文教基金會長期投入藝文推廣，看見廠內同仁在工作之餘能積極展現自己的興趣，決定今年把賽事擴大至全台灣，讓日月光中壢廠、矽品精密及環旭電子的同仁也能參加。賽事分華語組與外語組，晉級決賽的19位選手分別來自各廠區，其中10位為本國籍同仁、9位為外籍同仁，是各廠區同仁首次站上同一個舞台競技。
7月起，晉級選手利用週末往返高雄與台中，接受專業歌唱老師一對一指導，8月起再與伴奏樂團進行兩次現場彩排。冠軍可獲得獎金2萬元、亞軍1萬5千元、季軍1萬元。

決賽當天 家人到場 海外同步直播

決賽當天，選手的親友團到場加油。針對家鄉遠在數千公里之外的外籍同仁們，日月光也特別安排全程線上直播，讓身處海外的親友也能同步收看比賽實況。
活動主辦人日月光高雄廠處長林挺生表示：每年「日月光好聲音」的舞台上，都有許多令人感動的故事。過去曾有一名菲律賓籍同仁，在家鄉原是職業歌手，卻因嗓音受傷不得不放棄歌唱夢想，來台工作後，意外透過「日月光好聲音」重新站上舞台，並一舉奪得冠軍。領獎時，他更邀請太太與孩子一同上台，共享這份得來不易的榮耀，讓現場許多人深受感動。
另一名菲律賓籍女同仁則選唱《A Million Dreams》，將歌曲獻給遠在家鄉的孩子。她期盼透過在台灣努力工作，為孩子創造更好的生活與未來。對她而言，歌聲不只是表演，更承載著對家人的思念與對未來的期待。
林挺生指出，對許多第一線同仁，尤其是遠離家鄉來台工作的外籍同仁而言，平日在生產線上默默付出，未必有機會被大家看見，「日月光好聲音」希望做的，正是提供一個讓同仁展現自我、讓自己的聲音被聽見的舞台。許多參賽同仁也從這個舞台出發，陸續受邀參與文教基金會舉辦的年度慈善同樂會，公司尾牙及活動演出，從生產線上的工作夥伴，成為舞台上發光發熱的焦點。
林挺生分享，曾有外籍同仁告訴我，這一切就像做了一場很甜蜜的夢。能讓公司的董事長、總經理、主管以及自己的家人，看見自己站在舞台上的另一面，是許多同仁過去未曾想像的經驗；而這份被看見、被肯定與被鼓勵的感受，也正是「日月光好聲音」最珍貴的意義之一。
paras_en: Sunshine Investment Holding (3711-TW)(ASX-US) and its Sunshine Cultural Education Foundation, together with the Sunshine Group Joint Employee Welfare Committee, jointly organized the "2026 Sunshine Good Voice" event on November 11. This year’s competition attracted 297 employees from Taiwan, with 19 finalists advancing to the final round. Jiang Wanlin won the Mandarin category, while Timothy John Cachero claimed the foreign language category.

The "Sunshine Good Voice" is one of the annual series events of the "2026 Sunshine Music Season". It aims to provide professional guidance and support, giving employees a stage to showcase themselves beyond work, and allowing the outside world to see a different side of semiconductor plants.

Chairman Wu Tianyu of the Sunshine Cultural Education Foundation said that outsiders often think life at a semiconductor test plant is just work, shift, overtime. In reality, Sunshine’s nearly 100,000 employees worldwide often sing well but lack opportunities to be seen. The Good Voice program offers one‑on‑one coaching and band rehearsals, giving them a platform to perform a favorite song on a professional stage, and through live streaming it shortens the distance between foreign employees and their families.

With 297 applicants, competitors from each facility performed together on stage. Since 2022, the event has been hosted by the Kaohsiung plant and is now in its fifth year. The foundation’s long‑term investment in arts and culture led to expanding the competition nationwide this year, allowing participants from the Zhongli, Silgan Precision, and Huanxu Electronics plants to join. The competition is divided into Mandarin and foreign language categories; the 19 finalists come from various plants, with 10 local and 9 foreign employees—marking the first time employees from all facilities compete on the same stage.

Starting in July, finalists travel between Kaohsiung and Taichung on weekends to receive one‑on‑one coaching from professional vocal teachers, and from August they rehearse twice with an accompanying band. Winners receive a prize of 20,000 NT dollars for first place, 15,000 NT for second, and 10,000 NT for third.

On the day of the final, friends and family of the contestants came to cheer. For foreign employees whose hometowns are thousands of kilometers away, Sunshine arranged a full online live broadcast so overseas relatives could watch the live event in real time.

The event organizer, Kaohsiung plant director Lin Ting‑sheng, said that every year the "Sunshine Good Voice" stage hosts many touching stories. Previously, a Filipino employee who had been a professional singer in his hometown but had to give up his dream due to vocal injury found a new stage through the event and won the championship. He invited his wife and child to share the hard‑earned glory, moving many in the audience.

Another Filipino female employee sang "A Million Dreams," dedicating the song to her children back home. She hopes that by working hard in Taiwan she can create a better life and future for them. For her, singing is not just a performance but also a way to express longing for family and hope for the future.

Lin Ting‑sheng noted that for many frontline employees, especially foreign workers far from home, daily quiet contributions on the production line may go unnoticed. "Sunshine Good Voice" aims to provide a stage where employees can show themselves and have their voices heard. Many participants have since been invited to the foundation’s annual charity gala, company year‑end parties, and other performances, turning from production line teammates into shining stage highlights.

Lin shared that a foreign employee once told him this experience felt like a sweet dream. Seeing the chairman, general manager, supervisors, and family witness another side of him was an experience many employees had never imagined. The feeling of being seen, affirmed, and encouraged is one of the most precious meanings of "Sunshine Good Voice."

items.title: 美股派對進入倒數？AI行情浮現五大泡沫警訊
items.title_en: Is the US Stock Rally Counting Down? AI Market Shows Five Bubble Warning Signals
paras: 《巴隆週刊》報導，Capital Economics 警告，AI 題材推動的美股漲勢可能已進入泡沫末期。該機構追蹤的 8 項市場指標中，已有 5 項升至接近歷史極端水準，包括估值、獲利預期、指數集中度、股票發行及外資買盤。
不過，Capital Economics 資深市場經濟學家 James Reilly 認為，美股漲勢今年仍有延續空間。他預估，標普 500 指數可望在 2026 年底升至 8,250 點，但隨著泡沫消退，2027 年底可能回落至 6,500 點。
標普 500 指數近期走勢轉弱，截至週四 (10 日) 收盤，已較 8 月 13 日創下的 7,798.99 點歷史收盤高點回落 2.7%。儘管部分跌勢可能來自 8、9 月的季節性疲弱，但該指數今年以來仍上漲逾 10%，並可望連續第 4 年錄得雙位數漲幅。
Reilly 指出，近期回檔並不代表漲勢即將立即終結，但從一系列泡沫指標觀察，AI 股票熱潮可能已進入最後階段，中期前景也因市場過熱而轉趨不利。
首先，美股估值仍處於偏高水準。標普 500 指數預估本益比目前約為 21 倍，雖低於 2025 年底約 23 倍的高峰，美股相較其他市場的估值優勢也有所收斂，但 1999 年至 2000 年網路泡沫高峰前，美股同樣曾出現相對落後走勢，因此近期回檔並不足以證明市場不存在泡沫。
其次，現有估值隱含的企業獲利成長要求相當高。市場對未來 12 個月每股盈餘的共識預期，已升至與網路泡沫高峰相近的水準，而且這次並非反映企業獲利自低點復甦。由於成長預期主要集中在科技業，且高度仰賴長期獲利兌現，風險更加突出。
第三，標普 500 指數權重過度集中於少數科技巨頭。輝達 (NVDA-US) 與蘋果 (AAPL-US) 近期各占指數逾 7%，微軟 (MSFT-US) 的權重也超過 5%。Reilly 形容，目前大型科技股在指數中的集中程度已達令人擔憂的水準。
第四，股票發行活動正快速升溫，這也是泡沫進入後期常見的現象。若 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 日後推進市場高度期待的首次公開募股 (IPO)，相關指標可能進一步攀升。
第五，海外投資人對美股的買盤明顯增加，情況與過去市場觸頂前的資金動向相似。
相較之下，企業基本面、市場波動率與槓桿水準等另外 3 項指標，尚未升至足以發出警訊的極端程度。Reilly 因此並未判斷美股將立即反轉，但強調，隨著估值、獲利預期、市場集中度、股票發行及外資持股同步亮起紅燈，AI 股熱潮距離轉折點可能已愈來愈近。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reports that Capital Economics warns the AI‑driven US equity rally may have entered the late stage of a bubble. Of the eight market indicators the firm tracks, five have risen to near historic extremes, including valuations, profit expectations, index concentration, stock issuances and foreign buying.

However, senior market economist James Reilly of Capital Economics believes the US rally still has room to run this year. He forecasts the S&P 500 could reach 8,250 points by the end of 2026, but as the bubble fades it may fall back to about 6,500 points by the end of 2027.

The S&P 500 has recently weakened; as of Thursday the 10th it closed 2.7% below the August 13 historic closing high of 7,798.99 points. While part of the decline may stem from seasonal weakness in August and September, the index is still up more than 10% year‑to‑date and could post a double‑digit gain for a fourth consecutive year.

Reilly notes that the recent pullback does not mean the rally is ending imminently, but a suite of bubble metrics suggests the AI‑stock frenzy may be in its final phase and the medium‑term outlook is turning sour as the market overheats.

First, US valuations remain elevated. The S&P 500’s forward price‑to‑earnings ratio is about 21× now, lower than the roughly 23× peak expected at the end of 2025, and the valuation edge US stocks enjoy over other markets has narrowed. Yet before the 1999‑2000 internet bubble peak, US equities also showed a lagging trend, so the recent dip does not prove the bubble is gone.

Second, the profit‑growth expectations embedded in current valuations are very high. Consensus forecasts for earnings per share over the next 12 months have risen to levels comparable to the internet‑bubble peak, and this time they do not reflect a recovery from a profit trough. Because growth expectations are concentrated in tech and rely heavily on long‑term profit realization, the risk is amplified.

Third, the S&P 500’s weight is overly concentrated in a few tech giants. Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and Apple (AAPL‑US) each account for more than 7% of the index, and Microsoft (MSFT‑US) exceeds 5%. Reilly describes the current concentration of large‑cap tech stocks in the index as worrisome.
Fourth, stock‑issuance activity is heating up rapidly, a hallmark of a late‑stage bubble. If OpenAI and Anthropic eventually pursue highly anticipated IPOs, related metrics could climb further.
Fifth, foreign investors’ buying of US stocks has risen sharply, mirroring capital flows seen before past market peaks.

By contrast, three other indicators—corporate fundamentals, market volatility and leverage—have not yet reached extreme levels that would trigger a warning. Reilly therefore does not see an immediate reversal, but stresses that with valuations, profit expectations, market concentration, stock issuances and foreign holdings all flashing red, the AI‑stock boom may be edging ever closer to its turning point.

items.title: Fed升息恐非一次性！專家估最高升6次 華爾街警告：AI熱潮與私人信貸藏隱憂
items.title_en: Fed Rate Hikes May Not Be One-Off: Experts Estimate Up to Six Increases, Wall Street Warns of AI Boom and Private Credit Risks
paras: 金融市場普遍認定聯準會(Fed)下周將升息之際，經濟學家指出，Fed向來不滿足於只升息一次。因此市場接下來浮現兩個問題：利率將升到多高？而更緊縮的貨幣政策，是否會導致金融市場出現裂痕？
BMO Capital Markets美國利率策略主管Ian Lyngen表示，他假設Fed本月升息1碼後，10月及12月會議也將各升息1碼。
這將有效抵銷Fed前主席鮑爾(Jerome Powell)在2025年推動的三次降息，並使美國基準利率升至4.25-4.50%區間。

Fed可能升息一次，也可能升息六次之多

Vanguard資深美國經濟學家Josh Hirt表示，預期Fed升息三次，是思考Fed潛在走向「相當合理的起點」。他認為，Fed可能升息的次數範圍從一次到六次不等。
針對如此緊縮的貨幣政策可能帶來的影響，Monetary Policy Analytics政策經濟學家Derek Tang表示，目前在金融市場上，有兩個潛在脆弱領域相當明顯：一是支撐人工智慧(AI)支出周期的樂觀情緒，二是保險業持有的私人信貸資產，這些正是人們應該更加關注的面向。
與此同時，市場對美國預算赤字的擔憂也日益升高。Rockerfeller International主席Ruchir Sharma近日在《金融時報》(FT)發表專欄文章指出，他擔心借貸成本升高可能讓AI熱潮中斷。原因在於，當大型科技公司必須與能為公債支付5%殖利率的政府競爭時，許多企業可能被排擠到債券市場之外。
安聯投資管理公司(Allianz Investment Management)資深投資組合經理Charlie Ripley也認為，10年期美債殖利率若升至5%，可能讓市場風向轉為拋售。
Ripley指出，AI競賽中的「超大規模雲端業者」(hyperscalers)有龐大的融資需求，市場推估未來幾年每年資本支出將達1兆美元。一旦長天期公債殖利率走高，將推升所有這些借貸的成本。

私人信貸風險恐波及銀行業

國際貨幣基金(IMF)則警告，那些由私募股權公司部分持股或全資持有的保險公司，資產狀況並不透明。這些私募股權公司一直把資金投入風險較高的固定收益資產，而利率環境波動造成的損失，可能進一步蔓延至銀行業。
不過，Vanguard的Hirt表示，Fed今年可能啟動的升息周期，與過去導致重大金融危機的升息周期有所不同，例如2023年矽谷銀行(Silicon Valley Bank)倒閉，以及1994年加州橘郡(Orange County)破產。
他指出，Fed最近一次大規模升息周期發生在2022年至2024年間，目前利率普遍仍處於高檔，因此這次並不是市場預期突然轉向。
Hirt表示，在那些著名的金融危機案例中，Fed當時是徹底顛覆敘事。但這一次，Fed只是試圖找到一個能對通膨施加抑制力量的利率水準。
歷史上也有例外，並非每次升息都會帶來後續多次升息，例如1997年，Fed升息一次後，直到18個月後的那次降息前，都沒有再調整利率。
paras_en: When the financial market widely expected the Fed to raise rates next week, economists pointed out that the Fed has never been satisfied with a single hike. This raises two questions: how high will rates climb, and will tighter monetary policy create cracks in financial markets?
BMO Capital Markets U.S. interest rate strategist Ian Lyngen said he assumes the Fed will raise 1 basis point this month, and then 1 basis point at the October and December meetings.
This would effectively offset the three rate cuts the former Fed chair Jerome Powell is expected to push through in 2025, bringing the U.S. benchmark rate into the 4.25‑4.50% range.

The Fed could raise rates once or as many as six times. Vanguard senior U.S. economist Josh Hirt said that expecting three hikes is a fairly reasonable starting point, and that the number of hikes could range from one to six.

Regarding the potential impact of such a tight policy, Monetary Policy Analytics economist Derek Tang noted two vulnerable areas in financial markets: optimism supporting AI spending cycles, and private‑credit assets held by insurers—areas that deserve closer scrutiny.

Meanwhile, concerns about the U.S. budget deficit are rising. Rockerfeller International chairman Ruchir Sharma recently wrote in the FT that he fears higher borrowing costs could stall the AI boom, because large tech firms would have to compete with governments offering 5% yields on Treasury bonds, potentially pushing many firms out of the bond market.
Allianz Investment Management senior portfolio manager Charlie Ripley also believes that if the 10‑year Treasury yield rises to 5%, the market could shift toward selling.

Ripley pointed out that hyperscalers in the AI race have huge financing needs, with market estimates of $1 trillion in capital expenditures per year over the next few years. A rise in long‑term Treasury yields would raise the cost of all this borrowing.

The IMF warned that insurance companies partially or wholly owned by private‑equity firms have opaque asset positions. These private‑equity firms invest heavily in higher‑risk fixed‑income assets, and losses from rate volatility could spread to the banking sector.

However, Vanguard’s Hirt said the Fed’s potential rate‑hike cycle this year differs from past cycles that led to major financial crises, such as the 2023 collapse of Silicon Valley Bank and the 1994 Orange County bankruptcy.
He noted that the last large‑scale Fed rate‑hike cycle occurred from 2022 to 2024, and rates remain high, so this is not a sudden market reversal.
Hirt said that in those famous financial‑crisis cases, the Fed completely overturned the narrative. This time, the Fed is simply trying to find a rate level that can restrain inflation.
Historically, not every rate hike leads to subsequent hikes; for example, in 1997 the Fed raised rates once and did not adjust again until a cut 18 months later.

items.title: 阿曼灣成中東能源運輸新焦點：繞開荷姆茲海峽仍難避戰火風險
paras: 綜合外電報導，中東衝突持續升溫之際，阿曼灣正成為波斯灣能源運輸局勢中的關鍵區域。原本被視為可以繞過荷姆茲海峽的部分替代港口與管線，如今也受到軍事衝突與安全風險牽動。近期沙烏地阿拉伯東西管線遭到攻擊並暫停運作，更凸顯波斯灣國家即使建立了避開荷姆茲海峽(Strait of Hormuz)的運輸路線，仍難以完全擺脫區域衝突的影響。
其中，阿拉伯聯合大公國（UAE）東部的富查伊拉港（Fujairah）尤其受到關注。富查伊拉位於阿曼灣、荷姆茲海峽以外，阿布達比原油管線（ADCOP）可將原油從阿布達比的哈卜善輸送至富查伊拉，使部分原油出口不必經過荷姆茲海峽。然而，這類替代路線並不代表完全安全，因為富查伊拉及阿曼灣沿岸仍處於伊朗武器可能觸及的範圍內。
近期局勢更進一步顯示，「繞過荷姆茲海峽」並不等於「避開風險」。荷姆茲海峽的航運受到嚴重干擾之際，阿曼灣沿岸的港口與船舶也面臨無人機、飛彈及軍事衝突外溢的風險。換言之，波斯灣國家正在尋找替代出口，但替代路線本身也可能成為衝突的目標。

沙國曾成功降低對荷姆茲海峽依賴

在波斯灣國家尋找替代路線的過程中，沙烏地阿拉伯是目前最具代表性案例。
沙烏地阿拉伯可以透過東西管線（East-West Pipeline），將東部油田生產的原油輸送至紅海沿岸的延布港（Yanbu），從而避開荷姆茲海峽。這條管線長約1,200公里，每日運輸能力約500萬桶，長期被視為沙烏地阿拉伯最重要的荷姆茲海峽替代方案之一。
德國之聲此前指出，4月至5月期間，沙烏地阿拉伯波斯灣沿岸的貨運量大幅下降，而紅海方向的出口量則明顯增加。這顯示東西管線不只是緊急備援設施，也確實具備在荷姆茲海峽受阻時維持沙烏地原油出口的能力。
然而，近期東西管線遭到攻擊，迫使沙烏地阿拉伯暫停管線運作。這起事件凸顯另一項問題：即使能源出口改走陸上管線，也不代表可以完全避開戰爭風險。

阿曼灣替代路線的矛盾

阿聯酋的情況更能說明這個問題。
阿布達比原油管線可將原油輸送至富查伊拉，而富查伊拉以及鄰近的科爾法坎（Khor Fakkan）擁有重要的深水港設施。由於兩地位於阿曼灣，因此理論上可以讓部分能源出口避開荷姆茲海峽。
但富查伊拉距離伊朗仍然相對接近。《德國之聲》指出，儘管這些港口位於荷姆茲海峽之外，仍可能受到無人機與飛彈威脅；衝突期間，富查伊拉港以及阿聯酋東部沿岸附近作業的船舶都曾遭到攻擊。
因此，對波斯灣國家而言，阿曼灣並非單純的「安全替代出口」。它一方面提供了避開荷姆茲海峽的地理優勢，另一方面又因鄰近伊朗而承受新的軍事風險。
最新事件使這項風險更加明顯。沙烏地阿拉伯東西管線遭到攻擊後，原本用來降低荷姆茲海峽風險的替代出口本身也陷入中斷。這意味著，波斯灣能源運輸面臨的問題已經不只是「荷姆茲海峽能否恢復通航」，而是當主要航道與替代基礎設施同時面臨威脅時，波斯灣國家究竟還有多少真正可靠的出口能力。
也正因如此，波斯灣國家開始更加重視多元化的能源運輸網路。除了現有管線與港口之外，各國也在討論新的管線、港口以及陸路運輸方案，希望降低對單一海上通道的依賴。

替代方案仍有明顯限制

德國之聲指出，伊拉克與阿曼、約旦之間的新管線，以及繞行非洲好望角的海運路線，都被列為可能的替代方案，但這些計畫需要龐大投資，而且可能需要數年才能完成。
例如，經濟學家Hassan Mansour估計，巴士拉—亞喀巴管線可能需要5至7年、耗資約80億至100億美元；巴士拉—阿曼管線則可能需要100億至150億美元。若油輪改道經過好望角，每趟航程也可能增加數十萬美元的運輸成本。
因此，這些長期方案無法立即解決眼前的能源運輸問題。

紅海與曼德海峽又成為另一風險來源

此外，從波斯灣尋找替代路線，也可能只是把風險從一個海上瓶頸轉移到另一個瓶頸。
沙烏地阿拉伯利用東西管線將原油送往紅海沿岸後，相關能源出口仍需要面對紅海與曼德海峽的安全問題。胡塞武裝近期在葉門紅海沿岸的軍事行動，使曼德海峽及周邊航運再次受到關注。
這也形成波斯灣能源運輸目前最棘手的局面：荷姆茲海峽受到干擾，阿曼灣的替代港口面臨安全風險，而紅海與曼德海峽同樣存在軍事威脅。

波斯灣國家開始尋求外交「第二條路」

在能源運輸路線受到多重威脅的情況下，波斯灣國家也開始尋找外交上的緩衝空間。
最新消息顯示，波斯灣合作理事會（GCC）國家與伊朗方面計畫在阿曼舉行會談，討論商業船舶經由荷姆茲海峽安全通行的安排。這場由阿曼推動的接觸，也顯示阿曼在當前危機中扮演的外交角色受到重視。
而此前報導也指出，伊朗方面曾提出召集波斯灣及阿曼灣沿岸國家外長會議，並將建立商業航運安全通道列為討論內容之一。波斯灣國家與伊朗之間的接觸，反映出各國在軍事與能源風險升高之際，也在尋找降低衝突成本的方式。

波斯灣能源運輸正在重新布局

從沙烏地阿拉伯的東西管線，到阿聯酋的富查伊拉港，再到紅海、曼德海峽以及阿曼灣，當前波斯灣能源運輸正在形成一個更加複雜的格局。
沙烏地阿拉伯已證明，透過陸上管線可以在一定程度上降低對荷姆茲海峽的依賴；阿聯酋也擁有通往阿曼灣的能源出口設施。但近期事件同樣證明，替代路線的存在並不代表風險消失，而是可能將風險轉移到新的港口、管線與航道。
在目前的情況下，真正的挑戰已不只是尋找另一條能避開荷姆茲海峽的路，而是建立一套能夠在荷姆茲海峽、阿曼灣、紅海及陸上能源基礎設施同時承受壓力時，仍維持一定運輸能力的多層次網路。
而這也使阿曼灣從原本的替代性航道，逐漸成為觀察中東能源運輸與區域安全局勢的重要窗口。

items.title: 「笨蛋，問題是經濟」再現？美債殖利率逼近5% 川普中期選舉恐遇逆風
items.title_en: "Stupid, the problem is the economy" Reappears? U.S. Treasury Yields Near 5% and Trump Faces Midterm Headwinds
paras: 距離美國2026年中期選舉僅剩不到2個月，長天期美國公債殖利率持續攀升，10年期殖利率一度逼近5%關卡，與此同時，油價突破每桶100美元、通膨壓力升溫及聯準會利率政策不確定性同步發酵，讓川普政府面臨一項棘手問題：債券市場的壓力，最終可能透過房貸、汽車貸款、企業投資與生活成本傳導至選民身上，成為中期選舉的重要政治風險。
密西根州民主黨聯邦參議員候選人Abdul El-Sayed日前在社群平台X表示，近期美國債券市場拋售是「響亮的警鐘」，高通膨、伊朗戰事以及聯準會承受的政治與經濟壓力，正逐步動搖投資人信心。他批評川普政府試圖在中期選舉前為經濟注入「興奮劑」，但認為這種做法難以持久。
不過，債券市場目前的變化顯然不只是選舉政治。多數已開發經濟體的長期公債近期同步遭遇拋售，市場參與者關注的核心包括政府赤字、巨額發債、通膨黏著性、能源價格及央行利率政策。布魯金斯學會高級經濟學研究員Robin Brooks日前形容，這更像一場「緩慢發酵」的財政與債券市場壓力，而非突然爆發的金融危機。
疫情期間全球利率長時間維持在極低水準，之後各國又經歷激進升息週期，加上政府財政支出持續擴張，使主要已開發經濟體的長期借貸成本重新走高。如今市場開始重新評估，在高債務環境下，各國政府究竟能承受多高的長期利率。
美國的情況尤其受到關注。周四(10日)，美國10年期公債殖利率升至4.96%，創2023年底以來最高水準，周五盤中更一度觸及4.9915%，逼近5%心理關卡。路透社指出，若10年期殖利率持續突破5%，可能成為美國金融市場的重要轉折點，因為公債收益率升高將提高債券對股票的吸引力，並可能導致資金重新配置。
5年期美債殖利率同樣快速攀升，近期已突破4.7%，相較今年3月仍低於4%，短短數月內明顯上移。長天期殖利率上升的影響並不局限於金融市場，因為10年期美債殖利率同時是美國房貸、汽車貸款及企業融資成本的重要基準。
George Washington University政治學與國際事務教授Steven Kaplan長期研究選舉與債券市場的關係。他表示，利率持續攀升後，很快就會傳導至一般家庭的資產負債表，並可能在選舉期間產生連鎖反應。
這也是川普政府對長期利率走勢高度敏感的原因。美國財政部長Scott Bessent近期推出增加長天期美債回購的措施，希望改善市場流動性並降低長端殖利率。美國財政部9月宣布，將在9月10日回購最多60億美元、到期日在10年至20年的美國公債，規模是前一次長天期回購操作的3倍。
不過，債券市場對這項措施的反應並不熱烈。60億美元的回購規模相對於約32兆美元的美國國債市場仍然非常有限，投資人認為回購操作可以改善部分舊債券的流動性，但難以改變美國政府大規模發債、財政赤字擴大及通膨壓力所形成的供需結構。
美國國債規模近期已突破40兆美元，財政赤字也持續處於高檔。路透社最新數據顯示，美國2026年8月聯邦預算赤字為1670億美元，2026財政年度至今累計赤字達1.97兆美元，已超過2025財政年度全年1.775兆美元的赤字。與此同時，財政年度至今的利息支出增加1430億美元，年增13%，顯示高利率正在進一步提高政府財政負擔。
Bessent則認為，美國經濟基本面依然「非常強勁」，如果伊朗衝突得到控制，能源價格及通膨壓力回落，長期利率也可能隨之下降。他同時重申，人工智慧(AI)所帶來的生產力提升最終可能產生「極為顯著的通縮效應」，甚至可能在約6個月內開始反映。
問題在於，對即將面臨中期選舉的川普政府而言，6個月可能太久。2026年美國中期選舉將於11月3日舉行，距今已不到2個月，選民對生活成本及經濟表現的感受可能比任何長期生產力預期更直接。
路透社與Ipsos近期民調顯示，川普支持率維持在33%的政治生涯低點之一，經濟問題及伊朗戰事是主要拖累因素。更值得注意的是，71%的美國人不認同川普處理生活成本問題的方式，其中包括約4成共和黨選民；只有22%表示認同。
同一份民調顯示，民主黨在經濟議題上的評價近期也出現多年來少見的優勢。登記選民已連續一個月認為民主黨比共和黨更能處理經濟問題，這是約10年來民主黨首次在這項指標取得領先。
這使得「生活成本」成為川普政府在中期選舉前最敏感的經濟議題之一。即使一般選民未必理解10年期美債殖利率、聯準會政策或財政赤字之間的複雜關係，他們卻會直接感受到房貸利率、信用卡利率、汽車貸款及日常商品價格的變化。
Kaplan認為，選民未必會將高利率直接歸咎於財政部長Bessent，但更可能將經濟結果與總統川普連結。這與通膨的政治效應十分類似，民眾可能不會關注聯準會2%的通膨目標，也不會區分個人消費支出物價指數(PCE)與消費者物價指數(CPI)，但牛肉、雞蛋及汽油價格上漲，卻能直接改變他們對經濟的感受。
同樣地，如果高利率讓民眾買不起房子，或者企業因為融資成本提高而縮減投資、凍結招聘，這些變化最終都可能轉化成選民對政府經濟政策的評價。
這也是經典政治學研究所強調的「經濟投票」效應。政治學家Edward Tufte在1978年的研究中分析1938年至1970年的美國選舉資料，認為總統支持率及選民實際購買力的變化，與執政黨在全國選舉中的得票表現高度相關。1992年Bill Clinton競選總統時提出的「笨蛋，問題是經濟」之所以成為經典競選口號，正是因為經濟表現往往比複雜的政策辯論更直接影響選民投票。
因此，當前美債市場的壓力對川普政府而言，不只是華爾街的金融問題。投資人目前同時評估美國通膨、聯準會政策、政府債務規模以及政府是否具備控制赤字的政治意願，而這些因素最終都可能透過借貸成本及生活成本反映在選民身上。
Kaplan表示，美國經濟實力本身並沒有受到根本質疑，真正的問題是政治意願。無論是削減政府支出、改革福利制度或提高稅收，都可能有助於改善美國長期財政狀況，但這些措施也是政治人物在選舉前最不願碰觸的議題。
美國擁有美元全球儲備貨幣地位，因此相較其他國家仍有較大的時間與政策空間處理債務問題，但這項優勢並非無限。隨著美國政府債務突破40兆美元、財政赤字持續擴大，以及長期殖利率逐漸逼近5%，市場開始要求政府提出更可信的長期財政方案。
目前局勢仍遠未達到美國主權債務危機的程度，也與英國前首相Liz Truss任內因激進減稅方案引發的「特拉斯危機」有本質差異。當前長期殖利率走高，更像是債券市場向政策制定者發出的警告，而不是立即性的金融懲罰。
然而，這項警告正在逐漸變得更加明顯。美國10年期公債殖利率逼近5%，油價重新站上每桶100美元，伊朗戰事推升能源供應風險，加上美國財政赤字與政府債務持續擴大，使通膨、利率及財政政策開始形成相互強化的壓力。
聯準會也因此面臨更棘手的政策環境。路透社9月最新調查顯示，多數經濟學家仍預期聯準會在9月15日至16日會議維持利率於3.50%至3.75%，並維持至今年底，但隨著通膨及能源價格風險升高，預期今年至少升息一次的經濟學家人數正在增加。
更重要的是，8月CPI月增0.4%、年增3.4%，油價近期重新突破每桶100美元，使市場對通膨重新升溫的擔憂加劇。路透社指出，市場一度將9月升息25個基點的機率推升至約85%，顯示債券市場已開始對能源價格與通膨風險重新定價。
對川普而言，真正的政治風險並不是10年期美債殖利率單日是否突破5%，而是高利率與高生活成本能否在11月投票前持續轉化為選民的負面經濟感受。川普近期甚至提出，如果共和黨在中期選舉維持國會控制權，將向每名美國成年人發放5000美元「川普紅利」，但若以約2.7億名美國成年人計算，方案潛在成本約達1.35兆美元，也進一步引發外界對財政負擔的質疑。
與此同時，共和黨正加大中期選舉競選資金投入。路透社報導，川普已承諾投入約4億至5億美元協助共和黨競選，新成立的No Going Back超級政治行動委員會已預訂超過7400萬美元電視廣告，鎖定15場眾議院及參議院激戰選區，其中密西根州就投入1570萬美元。
因此，美債市場正在成為川普政府中期選舉前不可忽視的政治變數。只要長期殖利率持續攀升，並進一步推高房貸、汽車貸款及企業融資成本，同時油價維持在高檔，選民感受到的「經濟壓力」就可能比政府公布的宏觀經濟數據更加具有政治殺傷力。
目前市場尚未發出美國債務危機的正式警報，但5%的10年期殖利率關卡、40兆美元以上的聯邦債務、近2兆美元的年度累計財政赤字，以及能源價格重新升溫，已讓債券市場對華府的財政政策提出更直接的質疑。對川普政府而言，真正棘手的問題可能不是如何讓華爾街相信美國經濟仍然強勁，而是如何讓選民在11月投票前，相信自己的荷包確實正在變得更好。
paras_en: With less than two months left until the U.S. 2026 midterm elections, long‑term U.S. Treasury yields have kept climbing, with the 10‑year yield briefly approaching the 5% threshold. At the same time, oil prices have broken $100 a barrel, inflation pressures are heating up, and uncertainty over the Fed’s rate policy is brewing, creating a thorny problem for the Trump administration: pressure in the bond market could ultimately be passed through mortgages, auto loans, corporate investment and living‑costs to voters, becoming a major political risk for the midterms.

Democratic U.S. Senate candidate from Michigan Abdul El‑Sayed posted on X that the recent sell‑off in the U.S. bond market is a “loud warning,” with high inflation, the war in Iran and the political and economic pressure on the Fed gradually eroding investor confidence. He criticized the Trump administration for trying to inject an “excitement drug” into the economy before the midterms, but said such a move is unlikely to be sustainable.

However, the current bond‑market shift is clearly not just about election politics. Long‑dated sovereign bonds in most developed economies have recently been sold off in tandem, with market participants focusing on government deficits, massive debt issuance, sticky inflation, energy prices and central‑bank rate policy. Robin Brooks, a senior economist at the Brookings Institution, described it as a slowly fermenting fiscal and bond‑market pressure rather than a sudden financial crisis.

During the pandemic, global rates stayed at historically low levels for a long time, after which many countries entered aggressive rate‑hiking cycles. Combined with continuously expanding fiscal spending, the cost of long‑term borrowing in major developed economies has risen again. Markets are now reassessing how high long‑term rates governments can bear in a high‑debt environment.

The U.S. case is especially watched. On Thursday (the 10th), the 10‑year Treasury yield rose to 4.96%, the highest since the end of 2023, and on Friday intraday it briefly hit 4.9915%, edging close to the psychological 5% barrier. Reuters noted that if the 10‑year yield consistently breaks 5%, it could mark a pivotal turning point for U.S. financial markets, as higher yields make bonds more attractive relative to stocks and could trigger a reallocation of capital.

The 5‑year Treasury yield is also climbing fast, having recently broken 4.7%—up from below 4% in March—showing a clear upward move in just a few months. The rise in long‑term yields matters beyond financial markets because the 10‑year Treasury rate is a key benchmark for U.S. mortgage, auto‑loan and corporate financing costs.

Steven Kaplan, a professor of political science and international affairs at George Washington University who has long studied the link between elections and bond markets, said that once rates keep rising, the impact quickly spreads to ordinary households’ balance sheets and can create a chain reaction during an election.

That is why the Trump administration is highly sensitive to the direction of long‑term rates. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent recently announced a program to increase long‑dated Treasury repurchases to improve market liquidity and lower the long‑end yield. The Treasury said in September it will repurchase up to $6 billion of Treasury securities maturing in 10‑20 years on September 10, three times the size of the previous long‑dated buy‑back operation.

The market’s reaction to the measure has been muted. A $6 billion repurchase is tiny compared with the roughly $32 trillion U.S. Treasury market, and investors see the buy‑back as a way to improve liquidity for some older bonds but insufficient to change the supply‑demand dynamics created by massive U.S. debt issuance, expanding deficits and inflation pressure.

U.S. Treasury debt has recently topped $40 trillion, and deficits remain high. Reuters’ latest data show the federal budget deficit for August 2026 was $167 billion, with cumulative deficits for the 2026 fiscal year reaching $1.97 trillion—already exceeding the full‑year deficit of $1.775 trillion in FY 2025. Interest outlays for the fiscal year so far have risen by $143 billion, up 13% year‑over‑year, indicating that higher rates are further increasing the government’s fiscal burden.

Bessent argues that the U.S. economic fundamentals are still “very strong,” and that if the Iran conflict is contained, energy prices and inflation ease, long‑term rates could fall as well. He also reiterated that productivity gains from artificial intelligence could eventually generate a “very significant deflationary effect,” possibly showing up within about six months.

The problem for the Trump administration, which faces the midterms, is that six months may be too long. The 2026 U.S. midterm elections are scheduled for November 3, less than two months away, and voters’ perception of living‑costs and economic performance may be far more immediate than any long‑term productivity forecasts.

Recent Reuters and Ipsos polls show Trump’s approval rating hovering at about 33%, one of the lowest points of his political career, with economic issues and the Iran war being the main drag. Notably, 71% of Americans disapprove of Trump’s handling of living‑costs, including roughly 40% of Republican voters; only 22% approve.

The same poll shows the Democratic Party’s rating on economic issues has recently achieved a rare advantage. Registered voters have for a month now said Democrats are better than Republicans at handling the economy, the first time in about a decade the Democrats have led on this metric.

This makes “cost of living” one of the most sensitive economic topics for the Trump administration ahead of the midterms. Even if most voters do not understand the complex links between the 10‑year Treasury yield, Fed policy or the deficit, they will feel directly the changes in mortgage rates, credit‑card rates, auto‑loan costs and everyday prices.

Kaplan believes voters may not directly blame Treasury Secretary Bessent for high rates, but they are more likely to link the economic outcomes to President Trump. This mirrors the political effect of inflation: people do not focus on the Fed’s 2% inflation target or distinguish between the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) index and the consumer price index (CPI), but rising beef, egg and gasoline prices instantly shape their perception of the economy.

Similarly, if high rates make homes unaffordable or force companies to cut investment and freeze hiring because financing costs rise, those changes can ultimately translate into voters’ assessment of the government’s economic policy.

That is the classic “economic voting” effect emphasized in political‑science research. Edward Tufte’s 1978 study of U.S. elections from 1938 to 1970 found a strong correlation between presidential approval, voters’ real purchasing power and the incumbent party’s vote share. Bill Clinton’s 1992 campaign slogan “Stupid, the problem is the economy” became iconic because economic performance often outweighs complex policy debates in influencing voter choices.

Thus, the current pressure in the Treasury market is not just a Wall Street issue for the Trump administration. Investors are simultaneously assessing U.S. inflation, Fed policy, the size of government debt and the political will to curb deficits, all of which could ultimately be reflected in borrowing costs and living‑costs that voters feel.

Kaplan says the strength of the U.S. economy itself is not fundamentally in doubt; the real issue is political will. Whether it is cutting spending, reforming welfare or raising taxes, those steps could improve the long‑term fiscal outlook but are the very topics politicians avoid before an election.

Because the dollar remains the world’s reserve currency, the United States has more time and policy space than other countries to deal with its debt, but that advantage is not unlimited. With Treasury debt now over $40 trillion, deficits expanding and long‑term yields edging toward 5%, markets are demanding a more credible long‑term fiscal plan.

The situation is still far from a sovereign debt crisis and differs fundamentally from the “Truss crisis” in the U.K., which was triggered by aggressive tax cuts. The current rise in long‑term yields is more a warning from the bond market to policymakers than an immediate financial punishment.

Nevertheless, that warning is becoming increasingly clear. The 10‑year Treasury yield is near 5%, oil has returned above $100 a barrel, the Iran conflict is raising energy‑supply risks, and the growing U.S. deficit and debt are causing inflation, rates and fiscal policy to reinforce each other.

The Fed now faces a tougher policy environment. Reuters’ September survey shows most economists still expect the Fed to keep rates at 3.50%‑3.75% at its September 15‑16 meeting and hold them there through year‑end, but as inflation and energy‑price risks rise, the number of forecasters expecting at least one more hike this year is growing.

More importantly, August’s CPI rose 0.4% month‑over‑month and 3.4% year‑over‑year, and oil has again broken $100 a barrel, intensifying market worries about a resurgence of inflation. Reuters noted that the probability of a 25‑basis‑point rate hike in September was pushed up to about 85%, showing the bond market is re‑pricing energy‑price and inflation risks.

For Trump, the real political risk is not whether the 10‑year yield breaches 5% on a single day, but whether high rates and high living‑costs can continue to translate into negative economic sentiment among voters before the November vote. Trump has even floated a “Trump dividend” of $5,000 for every adult American if Republicans retain congressional control in the midterms; at roughly 270 million adults, the plan would cost about $1.35 trillion, sparking further doubts about fiscal sustainability.

At the same time, Republicans are ramping up campaign spending for the midterms. Reuters reported that Trump has pledged roughly $400‑$500 million to help the GOP’s campaign, and the newly formed No Going Back super‑PAC has booked more than $74 million in TV ads targeting 15 competitive House and Senate races, including $15.7 million in Michigan.

Thus, the Treasury market is becoming an unavoidable political variable for the Trump administration ahead of the midterms. As long as long‑term yields keep climbing, pushing up mortgage, auto‑loan and corporate‑financing costs while oil stays high, the “economic pressure” voters feel could be more politically damaging than any macro‑economic data the government releases.

The market has not yet issued a formal debt‑crisis alert, but the 5% 10‑year yield threshold, over $40 trillion in federal debt, nearly $2 trillion in annual cumulative deficits and the re‑heating of energy prices have already prompted the bond market to question Washington’s fiscal policy more directly. For the Trump administration, the real challenge may not be convincing Wall Street that the U.S. economy remains strong, but convincing voters that their wallets are actually getting better before they head to the polls in November.

items.title: 油輪運費飆至基準4.5倍！中東戰火如何推高每桶原油成本
items.title_en: Oil Tanker Freight Soars to 4.5 Times the Benchmark! How Middle East Conflict Pushes Up Crude Oil Costs per Barrel
paras: 中東局勢持續惡化正透過能源運輸市場向全球經濟傳導。本周，國際油輪運費隨著美伊雙方交火規模擴大而攀升至歷史峰值，市場對通膨壓力重燃的擔憂隨之加劇。
據波羅的海交易所數據，中東阿曼灣至中國的超大型油輪（VLCC）運費本周飆升至國際油運基準費率（Worldscale）的450左右，即正常基準運費的4.5倍，折合每桶運費約11.50美元，創下該航線開通以來的最高紀錄。
該航線正是在美以與伊朗戰爭爆發後啟用。運費飆升表明中東衝突正向更廣泛的經濟層面蔓延。若高企的運輸成本持續，將加大通膨壓力，令本已面臨衝突擴大化不確定性的企業和消費者承受更多成本負擔。
周五稍早，葉門叛軍「青年運動」(Houthi movement)發言人葉海亞·薩雷亞9月11日發布的影片聲明稱，青年運動自9月3日起對葉門西海岸「沙烏地支持力量」發動大規模攻勢，9天內攻佔塔伊茲和荷臺達省6個地區，面積達5,400平方公里。青年運動方面還稱，行動造成數百名敵方人員死傷或被俘，並攔截32架次沙特戰機、擊落9架無人機。
國際媒體指出，青年運動攻佔紅海港口城市穆哈後，曼德海峽航運受到明顯影響。當地時間10日15時許，僅6艘船隻通過曼德海峽，而9日為30艘、8日和7日分別為26艘和29艘。青年運動在攻佔穆哈後繼續向曼德海峽及周邊島嶼推進，紅海航道格局面臨新的變化。
能源數據公司Vortexa分析師Ioannis Papadimitriou表示，美國海軍與伊朗之間不斷更新的交火持續將海灣地區運費推向新高。
他補充，在中東海灣及周邊水域作業的風險上升，阿曼灣運費承壓走高，區域內可調配油輪數量隨之收緊。
中東局勢的軍事升級已產生更廣泛的連鎖反應，運費壓力並不局限於海灣地區。據路透社報導，西非至亞洲航線的超大型油輪運費同樣刷新歷史高位，顯示油輪市場整體供需格局已受到波及。
分析人士指出，中東區域風險溢價的擴大令船東傾向於規避高危航線，可調配運力在全球範圍內重新分配，從而帶動其他主要航線運價同步走高。
這個溢出效應意味著，即便衝突未直接影響某條航線，全球原油採購方和煉油企業同樣難以置身事外。
油輪運費上漲直接推高原油到岸成本，並沿產業鏈向成品油及下游消費品傳導，在當前通膨形勢尚未完全穩定的背景下，此傳導路徑引發市場對價格壓力再度抬頭的警惕。
paras_en: The deteriorating situation in the Middle East is transmitting through the energy transportation market to the global economy. This week, international oil tanker freight surged to a historic peak as the scale of fighting between the United States and Iran expanded, intensifying concerns that inflationary pressure is reigniting.

According to data from the Baltic Exchange, freight for ultra‑large crude carriers (VLCCs) on the Oman Bay‑to‑China route jumped this week to around 450 on the Worldscale index, roughly 4.5 times the normal benchmark rate, equivalent to about $11.50 per barrel – the highest level recorded since the route was opened.

The route was launched after the outbreak of the US‑Israel‑Iran war. The freight spike shows that the Middle‑East conflict is spilling over into broader economic dimensions. If elevated shipping costs persist, they will add to inflationary pressure and force businesses and consumers already facing uncertainty from a widening conflict to shoulder higher costs.

Earlier on Friday, a video released on September 11 by Houthi movement spokesperson Yahya Saree announced that the movement had launched a large‑scale offensive on the Saudi‑backed forces on Yemen’s western coast starting September 3, capturing six districts in Taiz and Hadhramaut provinces covering 5,400 square kilometres within nine days. The Houthis said the operation caused hundreds of enemy casualties or captures, intercepted 32 Saudi aircraft sorties and shot down nine drones.

International media noted that after the Houthis seized the Red Sea port city of Mocha, shipping through the Bab al‑Mandeb Strait was noticeably affected. Around 15:00 local time on the 10th, only six vessels passed the strait, compared with 30 on the 9th and 26 and 29 on the 8th and 7th respectively. After taking Mocha, the Houthis continued to push toward the strait and nearby islands, reshaping the Red Sea shipping landscape.
Energy data firm Vortexa analyst Ioannis Papadimitriou said the ongoing exchanges of fire between the U.S. Navy and Iran are continuously pushing Gulf freight rates to new highs.
He added that rising operational risks in the Gulf and surrounding waters are putting upward pressure on Oman Bay freight, tightening the pool of tankers that can be deployed in the region.

The military escalation in the Middle East has triggered broader chain reactions, and freight pressure is not confined to the Gulf. Reuters reported that VLCC freight on the West Africa‑to‑Asia route also hit historic highs, indicating that the overall supply‑demand balance in the tanker market has been affected.

Analysts point out that the widening risk premium in the Middle East is prompting shipowners to avoid high‑risk routes, reallocating available tonnage globally and driving up rates on other major lanes simultaneously.
This spill‑over effect means that even if a conflict does not directly touch a particular route, oil purchasers and refiners worldwide cannot remain insulated.

Rising tanker freight directly lifts the landed cost of crude oil and transmits through the value chain to refined products and downstream consumer goods. In a backdrop where inflation has not fully stabilised, this transmission path has revived market vigilance about renewed price pressure.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲 Fed下周升息可能性提高
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Rises as Fed Rate‑Hike Likelihood Increases Next Week
paras: 美元周五(11日)小幅走高，受到消費者通膨報告推升聯準會(Fed)升息預期的提振。但就本周而言，美元變化不大，交易員反而將注意力集中在美國公債殖利率及日元的大幅反彈上。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)0.1%，報99.13。
匯市參與者周五將焦點集中在最新公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)報告。根據美國勞工統計局(BLS)，8月整體CPI與核心CPI月增率分別為0.4%和0.3%，市場原先預期分別為0.4%和0.2%，且兩者均較7月的0.1%和0.2%加快。
以年增率來看，8月整體CPI上升3.4%，與7月持平。核心CPI則從2.5%降至2.4%，兩項數據均符合市場預期。
CPI數據進一步推升聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)下周升息25個基點的可能性。根據CME FedWatch工具，通膨數據公布後，市場預期升息25個基點的機率從數據公布前約69%，大幅升至接近87%。
儘管PPI和CPI都是市場密切關注的通膨指標，但FOMC更重視個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數，將其視為主要通膨衡量指標。PPI和CPI中的部分項目會納入PCE計算，而PCE通膨率已連續65個月高於聯準會長期2%的目標。
在8月CPI公布前，市場對升息的預期已逐步升溫。7月時，3位地區聯準會主席對FOMC維持利率不變的決定提出異議，到了8月底，聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)年度央行年會上發表明顯偏鷹的演說，指出潛在通膨趨勢並未改善。
同時，其他經濟指標也進一步提高貨幣政策收緊的可能性，包括上周大幅優於預期的非農就業報告，以及周四公布、顯示整體通膨加速的8月生產者物價指數(PPI)報告。
此外，美國與伊朗局勢升溫導致近期油價大幅上漲，進一步加劇市場對通膨的擔憂，也增加美國民眾加油的負擔。美國柴油價格周四更首次突破每加侖6美元。
美國債券市場尤其反映出市場對升息預期持續升溫的情況。自聯準會7月利率決策前後，美債市場便陷入拋售，尤其是長天期債券跌勢更加明顯。殖利率隨後大幅攀升，推動美國30年期公債殖利率升至近20年高點，也促使美國財政部提高長天期公債的回購規模。
然而，美國財政部出乎市場預期的干預並未達到預期效果。CPI公布後，美債周五大致持續走弱，10年期美債殖利率最新上升3.2個基點至4.976%，對利率更敏感的2年期殖利率則上升8.8個基點至4.638%。
市場普遍認為，CPI數據成為最後一根稻草，使升息預期明確轉向升息。
Macquarie經濟學主管David Doyle表示，「我們的基本預期仍是聯準會下周升息，而CPI數據公布後，我們對這項判斷的信心進一步提高。在我們看來，在8月強勁的就業報告公布後，除非通膨數據出現偏鴿派的意外，否則維持利率不變的可能性就會降低。儘管數據內部細項顯示，月增核心PCE可能沒有那麼強勁，但整體而言仍足以支持升息25個基點。」
日元創5月初來首度連兩周上漲
日元自上周以來一直是外匯市場焦點。日元周五進一步升值，創下5月初以來首次連續兩周上漲。美元兌日元下跌0.5%至153.72，本周累計下跌1.6%。
日元近期大幅反彈，反映市場愈來愈相信日本銀行(BoJ)總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)及政策委員會將於9月18日升息。
東京周五公布，8月企業物價指數(CGPI)年增7.6%，高於市場預期的7.4%，顯示進口成本飆升正直接傳導至日本國內的生產端通膨壓力。
DBS分析師指出，儘管市場普遍預期日本銀行將升息25個基點，但市場真正關注的將是政策制定者是否釋放出「彈性、取決於經濟數據」的政策路徑訊號，而非承諾快速連續升息。
歐元在ECB升息後周線下跌
歐元兌美元下跌0.1%至1.1597美元，本周累計下跌0.2%。
歐元走弱之際，歐洲央行(ECB)周四將主要政策利率上調25個基點。ECB表示，中東衝突導致能源價格上漲，持續帶來價格壓力。
ECB在聲明中警告，衝突仍在「產生通膨壓力」，通膨率預計將在「一段較長時間內」明顯高於2%的目標。
此外，《彭博社》周四報導，知情人士透露，ECB官員預計將進一步升息，最快可能在下個月。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Friday (the 11th), buoyed by a consumer‑inflation report that lifted expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike. Over the week, however, the dollar showed little movement, and traders focused instead on U.S. Treasury yields and a sharp rebound in the yen.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, was up 0.1% at 99.13.

FX market participants on Friday centered on the latest Consumer Price Index (CPI) release. According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, August’s overall CPI and core CPI rose 0.4% and 0.3% month‑over‑month, respectively, versus market expectations of 0.4% and 0.2%, and both accelerated from July’s 0.1% and 0.2% gains.
On an annual basis, August’s overall CPI increased 3.4%, unchanged from July. Core CPI slipped from 2.5% to 2.4%, with both figures matching market forecasts.

The CPI data further boosted the probability that the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) will raise rates by 25 basis points next week. The CME FedWatch tool shows the odds of a 25‑bp hike jumping from roughly 69% before the data to nearly 87% after the release.

Although both the PPI and CPI are closely watched inflation gauges, the FOMC places greater emphasis on the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index as its primary inflation measure. Some items from the PPI and CPI feed into the PCE calculation, and the PCE inflation rate has now been above the Fed’s 2% long‑run target for 65 consecutive months.

Even before the August CPI was released, market expectations for a rate hike were warming. In July, three regional Fed presidents voiced dissent against keeping rates unchanged, and by the end of August, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivered a decidedly hawkish speech at the Jackson Hole annual central‑bank meeting, noting that underlying inflation trends had not improved.

At the same time, other economic indicators further raised the likelihood of tighter monetary policy, including last week’s non‑farm payrolls that far exceeded expectations and Thursday’s August Producer Price Index (PPI) report, which showed an acceleration in overall inflation.

In addition, heightened tensions between the United States and Iran have pushed oil prices sharply higher, intensifying inflation concerns and increasing the cost of fueling for Americans. U.S. diesel prices broke the $6‑per‑gallon mark for the first time on Thursday.

The U.S. bond market especially reflected the growing rate‑hike expectations. Since the Fed’s July rate decision, Treasury markets entered a sell‑off, with long‑dated bonds falling the most. Yields then surged, lifting the 30‑year Treasury yield to near a 20‑year high and prompting the Treasury to expand its long‑term bond buy‑back program.

However, the Treasury’s unexpected intervention did not achieve the desired effect. After the CPI release, Treasuries continued to weaken on Friday, with the 10‑year yield rising 3.2 basis points to 4.976% and the more rate‑sensitive 2‑year yield climbing 8.8 basis points to 4.638%.
The market broadly views the CPI data as the final straw that turned rate‑hike expectations decisively upward.

Macquarie chief economist David Doyle said, “Our baseline view remains that the Fed will raise rates next week, and the CPI release has increased our confidence in that judgment. In our view, after the strong August jobs report, unless inflation data surprise on the dovish side, the odds of a hold diminish. While some components of the data suggest core PCE may not be as strong, overall it still supports a 25‑bp hike.”
The yen posted its first consecutive two‑week rise since early May.

The yen has been a focal point in the FX market since last week. On Friday it appreciated further, marking the first back‑to‑back weekly gains since early May. The dollar fell 0.5% against the yen to 153.72, down 1.6% for the week.
The yen’s recent sharp rebound reflects growing market belief that Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda and the policy board will raise rates on September 18.

Tokyo reported on Friday that August’s Corporate Goods Price Index (CGPI) rose 7.6% year‑over‑year, above the 7.4% consensus, indicating that soaring import costs are directly feeding domestic production‑side inflation pressure.

DBS analysts noted that although the market broadly expects a 25‑bp rate hike from the BOJ, the real focus will be on whether policymakers signal a “flexible, data‑dependent” policy path rather than committing to rapid, consecutive hikes.
The euro fell on the weekly chart after the ECB’s rate hike.
The euro slipped 0.1% against the dollar to $1.1597, down 0.2% for the week.

As the euro weakened, the European Central Bank raised its main policy rate by 25 basis points on Thursday. The ECB said Middle‑East conflict‑driven energy price increases continue to exert price pressure.
In its statement, the ECB warned that the conflict is still “creating inflationary pressure,” and that inflation is expected to remain “significantly above the 2% target for a prolonged period.”
Additionally, Bloomberg reported on Thursday that sources said ECB officials anticipate further rate hikes, possibly as early as next month.

items.title: 高價咖啡撐不住了？30萬袋巴西豆準備湧入ICE倉庫
items.title_en: High Coffee Prices Losing Steam? 300,000 Bags of Brazilian Beans Set to Flood ICE Warehouses
paras: 全球咖啡交易商正準備把大批巴西阿拉比卡咖啡運往洲際交易所(ICE-US)倉庫，可望使已降至26年低點的認證庫存增加逾一倍，並對目前仍處高檔的咖啡價格構成下行壓力。
ICE Futures U.S.阿拉比卡咖啡期貨是全球咖啡定價基準，價格7月一度升破每磅3.5美元，創6個月新高，目前仍徘徊在每磅3美元附近。儘管市場預期2026/27年度將出現大量供應過剩，價格卻遲遲未明顯回落，分析師認為，主因在於ICE認證庫存極度短缺。

約30萬袋巴西咖啡準備交割

目前ICE阿拉比卡咖啡認證庫存不到22萬袋，其中約七成存放於比利時安特衛普，遠低於2000年代中期至2022年初通常介於100萬至500萬袋的水準。交易所庫存被視為衡量可供交割剩餘咖啡數量的重要指標，對期貨價格具有顯著影響。
兩名消息人士透露，大型農產品交易商Olam正尋求讓15萬至20萬袋咖啡取得ICE認證，以趕上12月期貨合約交割；另一家大型交易商Louis Dreyfus Company(LDC)也在進行類似安排。兩家公司均拒絕置評。
業界預估，可能送交ICE的咖啡合計約30萬袋，足以讓現有認證庫存增加逾一倍。雖然庫存仍無法回到交易商認為較為充裕的100萬袋水準，但一家大型農產品交易商的消息人士表示，這批供應仍可能壓低價格。
庫存回升也可能觸發程式交易。許多演算法基金設定在交易所庫存增加時自動賣出咖啡期貨，庫存下降時則進場買入，因此新一波咖啡取得認證並入庫後，可能進一步放大價格跌勢。

輸往比利時暴增245%釋出供應訊號

交易商與分析師通常把巴西對比利時出口量異常增加，視為烘焙商需求獲得滿足後，剩餘供應正流向交易所的訊號。一名大型咖啡交易商分析師估計，巴西8月出口的阿拉比卡咖啡中，約15萬袋超出烘焙商的平均需求，很可能送往ICE倉庫，9月預計還有更多貨物抵達。
根據巴西政府數據及券商Terra Investimentos分析，巴西8月對比利時咖啡出口量年增245.3%，達3.15萬公噸，相當於逾52.5萬袋、每袋60公斤的咖啡。
ICE資料顯示，目前已有逾6.2萬袋巴西咖啡運抵交易所倉庫，正等待分級與品質檢驗，以取得可用於ICE 12月期貨合約交割的認證，但最終有多少能順利通過檢查仍不清楚。
ICE在一定程度上扮演咖啡市場的「最後買家」，為過剩供應提供去處，因此只要庫存開始回升，便可能吸引投資人押注價格下跌。隨著巴西咖啡陸續抵達，支撐咖啡價格的庫存短缺題材正面臨轉折。
paras_en: Global coffee traders are preparing to ship a large batch of Brazilian Arabica coffee to Intercontinental Exchange (ICE‑US) warehouses, which could more than double the certified stocks that have fallen to a 26‑year low and put downward pressure on currently high coffee prices.

ICE Futures U.S. Arabica coffee futures are the global benchmark, spiking above $3.50 per pound in July to a six‑month high and now hovering around $3 per pound. Even though the market expects a massive oversupply in the 2026/27 season, prices have been slow to fall, analysts say mainly because ICE‑certified inventories are extremely scarce.

About 300,000 bags of Brazilian coffee are ready for delivery. ICE’s Arabica certified inventory is now under 220,000 bags, roughly 70% of which sit in Antwerp, Belgium, far below the mid‑2000s to early‑2022 norm of 1‑5 million bags. Exchange inventories are viewed as a key gauge of deliverable coffee and have a strong impact on futures prices.

Two sources said large agribusiness trader Olam is seeking to have 150,000‑200,000 bags certified by ICE to meet the December futures delivery, while another major trader, Louis Dreyfus Company (LDC), is making similar arrangements. Both firms declined comment.

Industry estimates put the total coffee that could be sent to ICE at about 300,000 bags, enough to more than double the current certified stock. Although inventories would still fall short of the roughly 1 million bags that traders consider comfortable, a source at a large agribusiness firm said the influx could still push prices lower.

Rising inventories could also trigger algorithmic trading. Many systematic funds are programmed to sell coffee futures automatically when exchange stocks rise and to buy when they fall, so a new wave of certified coffee entering warehouses could amplify the price decline further.

Exports to Belgium surge 245% signalling supply flow. Traders and analysts often view an abnormal jump in Brazil’s shipments to Belgium as a signal that roaster demand has been met and excess supply is moving to the exchange. One senior coffee trader estimates that of Brazil’s August Arabica exports, about 150,000 bags exceed average roaster demand and are likely headed for ICE warehouses, with more cargo expected in September.

According to Brazilian government data and brokerage Terra Investimentos, Brazil’s August coffee exports to Belgium rose 245.3% year‑on‑year to 31,500 metric tons, equivalent to over 525,000 bags of 60 kg each.

ICE data show that more than 62,000 bags of Brazilian coffee have already arrived at exchange warehouses and are awaiting grading and quality checks to become eligible for the December futures delivery, though it remains unclear how many will ultimately pass inspection.

ICE acts to some extent as the coffee market’s “last buyer,” providing an outlet for surplus supply. Consequently, any rebound in inventories could attract investors betting on price declines. As Brazilian coffee continues to arrive, the shortage narrative that has supported prices is facing a turning point.

items.title: 日本央行升息提速至一季一次？市場擔憂套利交易退潮放大股債波動
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Accelerates Rate Hikes to Quarterly? Market Fears Arbitrage Fade Amplifies Equity and Bond Volatility
paras: 市場對日本央行貨幣政策正常化的預期顯著提速。多數訊息指出，日本央行於9月18日會議將政策利率由1%調升25個基點至1.25%已幾成定局，利率水準將創下31年來新高。
彭博最新調查顯示，受訪的52位經濟學家全數預期9月升息，且約93%認為最遲明年1月會再度升息；預估升息步調將加快至「每季一次」的比例顯著攀升至46%，遠高於先前主流的「每半年一次」。不過，本輪緊縮周期的終點利率預估中位數仍維持在1.75%。
驅動升息預期的主因在於國內外物價壓力持續累積。日本8月企業物價指數年增率達7.6%，加上國際局勢推升布蘭特原油價格重返每桶100美元以上，抵銷了日元升值帶來的進口降溫效果。
此外，外圍政治因素也受到矚目，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)多次發表支持升息言論，日本財務大臣片山皋月則回應，將與美方保持密切溝通，繼續維護外匯市場秩序。
市場擔憂，日本央行若加快升息節奏，對於「借入低息日元、轉而投資海外高收益資產」的日元套利交易來說，將顯著增加借入日元的融資成本，壓低套利交易的利差空間，進而削弱對海外風險資產的資金支持。
另一方面，若升息同時伴隨日元快速升值，投資人償還日元債務時將面臨匯兌損失，可能觸發追加保證金或迫使槓桿部位平倉，形成「日元升值與資產拋售」相互強化的負向反饋，放大全球股債市場的波動。
Totan Research Institute首席經濟學家加藤出表示，日本央行可能會向市場傳達升息間隔通常約為三個月的訊號，市場焦點將在於央行會以多大力度暗示未來進一步提高升息頻率。
岡三證券首席債券策略師長谷川直也認為，美方的表態主要是在向日本政府施壓，要求其切勿阻撓央行推進政策正常化。
法國巴黎銀行日本首席經濟學家河野龍太郎分析，若審議委員佐藤綾野與淺田統一郎投下贊成票，顯示政府要求維持寬鬆的阻力已顯著減弱。日本央行審議委員增一行指出，基礎通膨雖接近2%，但未見大幅超越，暗示目前尚無大幅升息50個基點的即時風險。
paras_en: Market expectations for the Bank of Japan's monetary policy normalisation have accelerated sharply. Most reports indicate that the BOJ’s September 18 meeting will raise the policy rate by 25 basis points from 1% to 1.25%, a move that is now largely a foregone conclusion and will set a 31‑year high for rates.

A Bloomberg poll of 52 economists shows all of them expect a September hike, and about 93% think another hike will occur by January next year at the latest; the share expecting the pace to quicken to “once per quarter” jumps to 46%, far above the previously mainstream “once every six months”. Yet the median estimate for the terminal rate of this tightening cycle remains at 1.75%.

The main driver of the hike expectations is the continued build‑up of price pressures at home and abroad. Japan’s corporate price index rose 7.6% year‑on‑year in August, and Brent crude has surged back above $100 a barrel due to international tensions, offsetting the cooling effect of a stronger yen on import prices.

External political factors are also in focus. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has repeatedly voiced support for rate hikes, and Japan’s Finance Minister Shun‑suke Katayama responded that Japan will keep close communication with the U.S. and continue to maintain order in the foreign‑exchange market.

The market worries that if the BOJ speeds up the pace of hikes, the classic yen‑carry trade—borrowing low‑cost yen to invest in higher‑yielding overseas assets—will see borrowing costs rise sharply, compressing the spread and weakening funding for overseas risk assets.

Conversely, if rate hikes are accompanied by a rapid yen appreciation, investors repaying yen‑denominated debt could suffer foreign‑exchange losses, potentially triggering margin calls or forced liquidation of leveraged positions, creating a negative feedback loop of “yen appreciation and asset sell‑offs” that could magnify global equity and bond market volatility.

Kato, chief economist at Totan Research Institute, said the BOJ may signal that the typical interval between hikes is about three months, and market attention will focus on how strongly the bank hints at further increasing the frequency of hikes.
Naoya Hasegawa, chief bond strategist at Oka Securities, believes the U.S. statements are mainly aimed at pressuring the Japanese government not to obstruct the BOJ’s policy normalisation.

Ryu‑taro Kono, chief economist for Japan at BNP Paribas, analysed that if board members Ayano Sato and Ichiro Asada vote in favour, it would show that resistance to maintaining easy policy has markedly weakened. A BOJ board member added that core inflation is close to 2% but has not surged far beyond, suggesting there is no immediate risk of a large 50‑basis‑point hike at present.

items.title: 〈台幣〉買匯避險升溫 爆量貶值9分收31.638元
items.title_en: TWD Hedging Demand Rises, Massive Volume, Depreciates 0.09 to Close at 31.638
paras: 在國際油價攀升、美國升息壓力升溫的衝擊下，台北股匯市重挫，買匯避險力道湧現，新台幣今(11)日全日處貶值態勢，最低一度逼近31.7元價位，終場收在31.638元，貶值9分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值暴出29.38億美元天量。
新台幣今日以31.58元、貶值3.2分開出後，越走越低，午盤後開出全日最低價31.698元，買匯力道相當強勁，收盤前一小時貶值壓力才緩步收斂，高低價差1.18角。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元反而強彈超過0.4%，日元升值0.2%，泰銖、人民幣和星元微幅升值，新台幣最弱勢，收貶0.29%。
元大投顧分析，美國8月PPI年增5.4%、月增0.4%，高於市場預期，也推高各界對美國升息的預期，同時，美國10年期公債殖利率向上逼近5%關卡，也加深市場避險情緒。
paras_en: Amid rising international oil prices and mounting pressure for U.S. rate hikes, Taipei's stock and foreign‑exchange markets suffered sharp declines, prompting a surge in demand for TWD hedging. The New Taiwan dollar was on a depreciation trend throughout the day, briefly approaching the 31.7 per dollar level, and ultimately closed at 31.638, down 0.09. Taipei forex brokers reported a record‑high turnover of USD 2.938 billion.

The TWD opened today at 31.58, down 0.032, and kept sliding lower, reaching a intraday low of 31.698 after the lunch break. Buying pressure was strong, and only in the final hour before the close did the depreciation pressure ease slightly, resulting in a high‑low spread of 0.118.

Looking at other major Asian currencies, the Korean won actually rallied more than 0.4%, the Japanese yen appreciated 0.2%, and the Thai baht, Chinese yuan, and Singapore dollar showed modest gains, while the TWD was the weakest, ending down 0.29%.

Yuanta Securities analysis notes that U.S. August PPI rose 5.4% year‑over‑year and 0.4% month‑over‑month, exceeding market expectations and fueling expectations of further U.S. rate hikes. items.title: BOJ下周傳升息1碼！基準利率衝1.25%創31年新高 恐釋加速緊縮訊號
items.title_en: BOJ Expected to Raise Rates by 1 Basis Point Next Week! Benchmark Rate Hits 1.25% – 31-Year High, Signaling Accelerated Tightening
paras: 路透引述四名知情人士說法報導，日本銀行(BOJ, 央行)可望在下周升息，最可能升息1碼(25個基點)，且若物價壓力升高、通膨超標風險加劇，日銀可能釋出未來加速緊縮的訊號。
若日銀真如此消息把升息至1.25%，基準利率將攀抵31年來最高水準。這也將代表日銀在6月升息只過三個月就再次升息，形同緊縮步調加快，特別是考量到日銀可能釋出年底前再次升息的訊號。
許多日銀官員認為，再次升息的條件正逐步成熟，國內經濟有望溫和復甦，物價壓力也正在升高。知情人士則透露，即使日銀升息至1.25%，金融環境預料仍將保持寬鬆。
他們指出，日元近期回升之後，可能在抑制進口成本漲幅的情況下，緩解物價壓力，但日元前一段時間已經大幅貶值，加上燃料價格恢復上漲，仍將使日銀對通膨風險保持警戒。
日銀在6月將利率升至1%，並承諾若經濟與物價發展符合基礎預測情境，將進一步推高借貸升息。
日銀在7月會議上維持利率不變，但警告中東衝突、日元疲弱以及強勁的人工智慧(AI)相關需求正在加劇物價壓力，可能造成通膨超標風險，讓外界解讀近期升息可能性很高。
路透調查的分析師預期，日銀將在9月17日至18日的會議上升息至1.25%，明年3月底前升至1.5%，接著在2027年第2季升至1.75%。多數分析師認為，終端利率至少為1.75%。
9月之後，日銀將於10月、12月以及明年1月召開決策會議。
由於市場已完全反映9月升息預期，部分市場人士大膽押注日銀可能意外升息2碼(50個基點)，以帶來更大的驚喜。但由於目前沒有薪資與物價成長突然加速的迫切風險，知情人士表示，日銀下周可能仍會選擇常見的升息1碼，並等待更多數據，以判斷是否有必要再次升息。
日銀理事增一行(Kazuyuki Masu)周四表示，「核心通膨即將達到2%，但我們看不到大幅超過這一水準的情況」，這番話顯示他認為目前沒有通膨即將急遽飆升的跡象，因此下周沒有必要大幅升息。

終端利率沒有預設值

市場正關注日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)會後記者會的訊號，包括未來升息步調，以及日銀在本輪緊縮周期中利率可能升至多高。
知情人士表示，日銀可能沒有預設的終端利率，最終水準將取決於過去升息對經濟的影響，以及企業把成本上升轉嫁給家庭的程度。
日銀內部對升息速度也沒有共識，鷹派認為核心通膨已達2%，但也有反對6月升息的鴿派人士存在。
因此，知情人士表示，植田和男將避免給出有關未來升息的具體時間表，但可能重申7月的說法，也就是認為在金融環境過於寬鬆的情況下，日銀可能加快升息步調。
自7月底美日聯手干預匯市以來，日元已升值逾6%，儘管日元升值原本預料能引導進口成本下降的效果，但布蘭特原油本周重返每桶100美元之上，抵銷了日元升值帶來的效應，也讓人擔憂通膨壓力重新升高。
paras_en: Reuters quoted four insiders saying the Bank of Japan (BOJ, the central bank) is likely to raise rates next week, most probably by 1 basis point (25 basis points), and if inflationary pressures rise and the risk of inflation exceeding targets increases, the BOJ may signal a future acceleration of tightening.

If the BOJ indeed raises rates to 1.25%, the benchmark rate would reach its highest level in 31 years. This would also mean the BOJ would raise rates again just three months after the June hike, effectively speeding up the tightening pace, especially considering the possibility of another rate hike before year‑end.

Many BOJ officials believe the conditions for a second hike are gradually maturing, the domestic economy is expected to recover moderately, and price pressures are rising. Insiders say that even if the BOJ raises rates to 1.25%, the financial environment is expected to remain accommodative.

They pointed out that after the yen recently appreciated, it may help curb import cost increases and ease price pressures, but the yen had previously depreciated sharply, and with fuel prices rebounding, the BOJ will remain vigilant about inflation risks.
The BOJ raised rates to 1% in June and pledged to further lift borrowing costs if the economy and price developments align with its baseline forecast.

At the July meeting, the BOJ kept rates unchanged but warned that the Middle East conflict, a weak yen, and strong AI‑related demand are intensifying price pressures, potentially raising the risk of inflation exceeding targets, leading observers to interpret a high likelihood of a recent rate hike.

Analysts surveyed by Reuters expect the BOJ to raise rates to 1.25% at the September 17‑18 meeting, to 1.5% by the end of March next year, and then to 1.75% in Q2 2027. Most analysts believe the terminal rate will be at least 1.75%.
After September, the BOJ will hold decision meetings in October, December, and January next year.

Because the market has fully priced in the September hike, some market participants boldly bet that the BOJ might unexpectedly raise rates by 2 basis points (50 basis points) for a bigger surprise. However, since there is no urgent risk of sudden wage and price growth acceleration, insiders say the BOJ may still choose the usual 1‑basis‑point hike next week and wait for more data to decide whether another hike is necessary.

BOJ board member Kazuyuki Masu said on Thursday, "Core inflation is about to reach 2%, but we do not see a large overshoot of this level," indicating he sees no signs of a sudden inflation surge, so a large hike next week is unnecessary.
The market is watching the signals from BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda at the post‑meeting press conference, including the pace of future hikes and how high rates could rise in this tightening cycle.
Insiders say the BOJ may not have a preset terminal rate; the final level will depend on the impact of past hikes on the economy and how much firms pass cost increases onto households.
There is no consensus within the BOJ on the pace of hikes; hawks believe core inflation has reached 2%, but there are also dovish voices who opposed the June hike.

Therefore, insiders say Ueda will avoid giving a specific timetable for future hikes but may reiterate July’s stance, namely that in an overly accommodative financial environment the BOJ could accelerate the pace of hikes.

Since the joint US‑Japan intervention in the FX market at the end of July, the yen has appreciated over 6%. Although the yen’s appreciation was expected to lower import costs, Brent crude returned above $100 a barrel this week, offsetting the effect of the yen’s appreciation and raising concerns that inflationary pressure may rise again.

items.title: 日元近期強升非短線反彈？ 知名資管機構：低估修正啟動 回調即布局多頭
items.title_en: Yen's Recent Surge Not a Short-Term Bounce? Prominent Asset Management Firm: Undervaluation Correction Begins, Pullbacks Offer Bullish Positioning
paras: 日元近期強勢攀升，可能並非短期反彈，而是多年低估狀態進入更廣泛修正。歐洲資產管理公司Edmond de Rothschild多資產及對沖策略主管Michael Nizard最新表示，日元正擺脫長期由美日利差與套利交易主導的定價模式，重新回歸基本面。
Nizard說，「日元可能正在重新成為真正由基本面驅動的貨幣」，並稱未來回檔應視為重建，或是加碼日元多頭的機會。
本月以來日元已升值逾3%。日本央行(BOJ)加快緊縮的預期升溫，加上日本退休金資金配置可能改變，投資人紛紛平倉日元空單。美國財長貝森特此前更向交易員喊話「敢做空日元試試看」。
Nizard認為，近期美日聯合干預匯市同樣關鍵，市場原以為東京當局容忍日元貶值，聯合干預扭轉了預期，使日元貶值從「單向交易」變成漲跌風險並存的「雙向交易」。若日元續強，套利交易恐進一步平倉，槓桿下降將引發投資人拋售美債、信用債與股票；日本資金若回流國內，也將為全球債市帶來新波動。
他並提醒，修正過程不會是單方向，期間仍可能盤整甚至回弱，但只要趨勢不變，回檔都是布局多頭的機會。
基本面也出現改善。根據BOJ今(11)日公布的數據，8月企業商品價格指數(CGPI)年增7.6%，高於預期的7.4%，略低於7月修正後的7.7%，但月減0.2%。數據顯示，日企仍面臨能源、運輸、包裝與工資成本壓力，最終可能轉嫁消費者，推升通膨風險。
目前，市場普遍預估BOJ下周五(18日)將升息1碼至1.25%。
paras_en: The yen's recent strong climb may not be a short‑term rebound but rather a broader correction as it moves out of years of undervaluation. Michael Nizard, head of multi‑asset and hedge‑fund strategies at European asset manager Edmond de Rothschild, said the yen is shedding the pricing model long dominated by US‑Japan interest‑rate differentials and arbitrage trades, and is returning to fundamentals.

Nizard said, “The yen may be becoming a currency truly driven by fundamentals,” and added that any future pull‑back should be seen as a rebuilding phase, or an opportunity to add to long yen positions.

Since the start of the month the yen has appreciated by more than 3%. Expectations that the Bank of Japan will tighten faster are heating up, and possible changes in Japanese pension fund allocations are prompting investors to unwind short yen positions. U.S. Treasury Secretary Yellen earlier urged traders, “If you dare to short the yen, give it a try.”

Nizard sees the recent joint US‑Japan intervention in the FX market as equally pivotal. The market had assumed Tokyo tolerated yen depreciation; the coordinated intervention flipped that expectation, turning yen weakness from a one‑way trade into a two‑way trade with both upside and downside risk. If the yen keeps strengthening, arbitrage positions are likely to be further unwound, reduced leverage could trigger investors to sell U.S. Treasuries, credit bonds and equities; a repatriation of Japanese capital would also introduce new volatility to global bond markets.

He cautioned that the correction will not be unidirectional; there may be periods of consolidation or even temporary weakness, but as long as the trend remains intact, each pull‑back is an opportunity to build long positions.

Fundamentals are also improving. According to data released by the BOJ today (Nov 11), the August corporate goods price index (CGPI) rose 7.6% year‑on‑year, above the 7.4% forecast, slightly below the revised July figure of 7.7%, and fell 0.2% month‑on‑month. The data show Japanese firms still face pressure from energy, transport, packaging and wage costs, which could eventually be passed on to consumers, raising inflation risks.
Currently the market broadly expects the BOJ to raise rates by one basis point to 1.25% on Friday, the 18th.

items.title_en: Is the Yen’s Rally a Flash in the Pan? Barclays Flags Two Potential Bullish Catalysts May Miss
paras: 巴克萊表示，如果市場對日本央行加快升息，以及日本退休基金將資金轉向國內資產的預期未能實現，日元近期的急升走勢可能逆轉，兌美元恐回落至150區間高檔。
包括Shinichiro Kadota在內的策略師周四(10日)在報告中指出，日元近期走強，主要受到日本央行收緊貨幣政策的預期、退休基金資金流向的揣測，以及技術面因素推動。儘管美元兌日元跌破155附近的關鍵支撐，短期仍可能進一步走低，但長期壓抑日元的結構性因素大致未變。
日元本月迄今已上漲近4%，升至2月以來最強水準，市場看多情緒持續升溫。投資人對日本央行下周升息的預期增強，加上外界猜測日本政府退休金投資基金（GPIF）可能提高日本國內資產配置，進一步帶動日元需求。
美國財長貝森特也向交易員喊話，挑戰市場測試他推升日元的決心，並表示自己「相當清楚」日本決策官員接下來會採取什麼行動。
亞洲周四下午交易時段，日元小幅升值0.1%，報每美元兌153.45日元。
巴克萊警告，市場預期目前已處於高檔，若日元要進一步升值，日本央行可能必須釋出比預期更鷹派的訊號。市場也可能高估GPIF資金流向的潛在影響，若其資產配置最終未出現調整，日元恐面臨走勢逆轉。
此外，巴克萊指出，利差、日本股票風險溢價、外界對首相高市早苗政策的疑慮，以及結構性的日元賣盤，仍不利於日元持續升值。
paras_en: Barclays says that if market expectations of a faster rate‑hike cycle by the Bank of Japan and of Japanese pension funds shifting money into domestic assets fail to materialise, the yen’s recent sharp rise could reverse, with the dollar‑yen possibly slipping back into the high‑150s range.

Strategists, including Shinichiro Kadota, noted on Thursday (the 10th) that the yen’s recent strength has been driven mainly by expectations of tighter BOJ policy, speculation about pension fund flows and technical factors. Even though USD/JPY has broken below the key support near 155, it could still drift lower in the short term, but the structural headwinds that keep the yen subdued remain largely unchanged.

The yen is up almost 4% so far this month, reaching its strongest level since February, as bullish sentiment heats up. Investors’ expectations of a BOJ rate hike next week have risen, and speculation that the Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF) may increase its allocation to domestic assets is further boosting yen demand.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen also called out traders, challenging the market to test her resolve to support the yen, and said she is “quite clear” about what Japanese policymakers are likely to do next.
In the Asian afternoon trading session on Thursday, the yen edged up 0.1% to 153.45 per dollar.

Barclays warns that market expectations are already at elevated levels; for the yen to rise further the BOJ may need to signal a more hawkish stance than anticipated. The market may also be over‑estimating the impact of GPIF flows, and if the fund’s asset allocation does not adjust, the yen could see its rally reverse.

Barclays also points out that interest‑rate differentials, risk premiums on Japanese equities, concerns about Prime Minister Kishida’s policies, and structural yen‑selling pressure remain headwinds to any sustained yen appreciation.
